name: Classics (PMn)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
For a Ph.D. minor, the department requires 20 units of Classics coursework at the graduate level (i.e. courses numbered 200 and above). Other courses can count towards this requirement with written consent from the Director of Graduate Studies and notification to the Student Services Manager.
Those pursuing a Ph.D. minor in Classics must take one course in the Latin Core or Greek Core sequence. The remaining units (typically graduate seminars) must be selected in consultation with the candidate’s Classics advisor or Director of Graduate Studies. Before obtaining Classics department approval, students interested in this minor must discuss their proposed course plan with the Director of Graduate Studies and their Ph.D. department.

rules.name: One Latin Core or Greek Core course
Course plan approved by the Classics department

grading: One course can be taken as Credit/NoCredit; a letter grade is required for all other courses.
policies: All of the coursework for a minor must be done at Stanford and must be completed prior to a student moving to TGR status.
transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks 20 units of CLASSICS courses numbered 200 and above, one of them from the Latin or Greek Core sequence. One course may be Credit/No Credit; the audit counts at most 5 such units, about one Classics course. You check by hand the course plan the Director of Graduate Studies approves, and any course from outside Classics that the Director allows.

totals.label: One Credit/No Credit course (up to 5 units)
